blocks.title: No. 80: 漫画 / 故事板 - Kyudo Archery Anime Character Sheet
blocks.description: A highly detailed set of instructions for generating consistent character sheets and environment settings for anime-style Japanese archery (Kyudo) scenes, ensuring stability across frames.
blocks.prompt:
[Final Product] Use the single attached full-body reference image as the sole character reference to convert the subject into a high-quality anime character wearing dignified Kyudo attire while maintaining character identity. Create one 1:1 square practical character sheet that can be used for stable reference of the person, clothing, physique, and base color scheme in subsequent video generation. Stage settings are not handled by this sheet.
[Person Reference] Image A = 1 full-body reference image. Maintain the facial features, eyes, silhouette, nose, mouth, hairstyle, hair color, bangs, parting, physique, height, shoulder width, waist position, leg length, overall proportions, and character impression from Image A. Age and gender are not fixed in text but inherited from Image A. No excessive beautification, rejuvenation, alteration, face-shrinking, physique changes, or unnatural leg lengthening.
[Anime Conversion] Regardless of whether the reference is live-action or an illustration, unify the final character into a high-quality anime style. Ensure the face, hair, body, and clothing naturally blend into a consistent anime art style rather than an ambiguous semi-realistic expression.
[Hairstyle] Basically maintain the hairstyle, color, bangs, parting, and face-framing of Image A. Hair that is short to shoulder-length should remain as is; long hair should be naturally tied at a low position on the neck only if it would interfere with archery movements. Do not add large buns, high ponytails, or ornate hair ornaments not present in the reference.
[Kyudo Attire/Equipment] Do not style as simple practice wear; arrange as dignified Kyudo formal attire suitable for competition or performance. The basic set includes a white upper garment, black to dark blue hakama, obi, and white tabi socks, carefully depicting fabric layering, pleats, sleeves, and the drape of the hakama. The chest guard (muneate) must be consistent as the same equipment across front, side, and back views, with straps and support structures continuing naturally. Do not change the presence, shape, position, or fastening method of the chest guard between the three views. **The archer's glove (yugake) and wrist gear are worn on the RIGHT HAND ONLY. The left hand does not wear a glove in any of the three views. In the front view, the character holds a Japanese bow (Wakyu) with the left hand and wears a brown to ochre yugake on the right hand. In side and back views, the yugake must remain on the same right hand; do not perform changes such as horizontal flipping, swapping the wearing hand, bare hands in the side view, or adding it only in the back view. Glove shape, color, and wrist structure must match across all three views. Do not use purple, blue, or vivid accent colors.** The bow is clearly depicted as a Wakyu and held naturally in the left hand only in the front full-body view. In side and back views, the bow is removed to make the person, hair, and clothing structure easier to read.
[Sheet Composition] Align the front full-body, side full-body, and back full-body views of the same person in the same outfit at nearly the same scale and ground line, showing them from head to toe without cropping. The front view may be slightly larger, but do not treat side and back views as small decorations. Treat the three full-body views as the main focus of this sheet, completing the character information within these views. No face close-ups.
[Color Bar] Place a single thin horizontal 4-color proportional color bar in the bottom margin consisting of white tones, black to dark blue tones, warm tones from the glove, and dark brown tones from the hair or bow extracted from the finished character. Treat it as an auxiliary element to reinforce the character's basic color scheme and do not let it stand out more than the character. The bar should be stretched long horizontally at a low height and should not look like thick color swatches or an independent UI component. The four colors should be divided to reflect the color proportions of the character as a whole; do not include color names, HEX codes, explanatory text, or icons.
[Design/Layout] Unify the design to look like the same series as the stage setting sheet. Background is light gray near white. Place the title "KYUDO CHARACTER SHEET" at the top center with thin horizontal lines on either side. Align the front, side, and back full-body views in the center and place the thin proportional color bar at the bottom. Create design quality through the balance of margins, alignment of the three views, title, thin lines, and bottom color bar without adding extra decorative elements.
[Prohibitions] Face close-ups, multiple expression variations, action pose collections, tiny side/back views, stage backgrounds, long setting text, text other than the title, text-based decorations, thick/large color swatches, independent color chips, excessive Japanese patterns, family crests/bow-and-arrow icons, purple/blue wrist accents, **wearing the glove on the left hand, swapping hands for the glove between views**, fantasy elements, equipment unrelated to Kyudo, character alteration, or changes to hairstyle, physique, clothing, or gear between views.
[Priority] 1. Character identity, 2. Consistency of three views and practical utility for video reference, 3. Maintenance of physique and body proportions, 4. Consistent Kyudo attire, chest guard, and right-hand glove across three views, 5. Natural anime conversion, 6. Clarity of basic color scheme, 7. Unified design consistent with the stage setting sheet.
[Final Product] Create one high-quality anime-style Kyudo dojo stage setting sheet that can be used as a background and spatial reference for subsequent video generation. It does not handle character identity or Kyudo clothing; it organizes the same Kyudo dojo into backgrounds for the three main directions used in videos.
[Input Items] Aspect Ratio: [1:1]. Defaults to 1:1 if not entered.
[Basic Policy] Give top priority to practicality and reproducibility, unifying all three views as the same Kyudo dojo. Match the wood, pillars, floor, walls, ceiling, roof, target area, light direction, time of day, and color tone; do not change to different facilities, buildings, or designs. Fix the style as high-quality anime background art with clear morning to midday natural light and a quiet, calm Japanese atmosphere. Do not draw people.
[3-View Composition] 1. Top Main View: A standard view of the entire Kyudo dojo looking from the shooting area toward the target area. Use the top section largely to create a high-frontality composition where the line of sight from the shooter's position to the target, sense of distance, depth, and architectural structure on both sides are clear. 2. Bottom Left View: A side background that appears behind the person when filming the shooter from the side. Face the camera almost directly toward the side wall of the shooting area, creating a flat background centered on wooden floors, plaster walls, vertical pillars, and horizontal beams. Secure a wide blank wall surface where a person can be placed sideways. Do not include compositions showing a corridor receding, strong perspective, targets, windows, or recessed central wall structures. 3. Bottom Right View: A front background that appears behind the person when filming the shooter from the front. Make the symmetry high and provide a recessed rectangular blank wall section in the center surrounded by pillars and beams. Ensure enough space in the center to place a person front-facing, and keep the left and right simple with plaster walls and wood. Do not include windows, hanging scrolls, frames, or text decorations. Distinguish it clearly from the bottom-left view by providing a shallow depth in the center rather than a simple flat wall.
[Text Elements] Do not include any text within the stage space. Do not place hanging scrolls, frames, signs, tags, posters, slogans, calligraphy, or text-based decorations. Use only the title "KYUDO STAGE SETTING SHEET" at the top center of the sheet, and do not include explanatory labels or numbers within each view.
[Layout] Place the title and thin horizontal lines at the top center. Place one main view in the top section and the side and front backgrounds in two equal-sized columns below. The sheet background is light gray near white. Arrange the margins and keep decorations to a minimum.
[Prohibitions] Architectural changes between the three views, turning views into different facilities, corridor/diagonal perspective compositions in the bottom-left view, making bottom-left and bottom-right views identical, placing targets on the side walls, people, windows, readable text, text-based decorations, atmospheric cuts of unknown purpose, excessive Japanese-style presentation, overly dramatic backlighting, dark lighting, or adding numerous extra views.
[Priority] 1. Consistency of the three views as the same Kyudo dojo, 2. The relationship between the shooting area and target area in the top view, 3. Flat side background for the bottom-left, 4. Front background with shallow central depth for the bottom-right, 5. Clear structural difference between the bottom left and right, 6. Reproducibility for video reference, 7. Sense of organization as a shared sheet.

blocks.title: No. 81: 漫画 / 故事板 - Retro 90s Urban Album Art
blocks.description: A stylized prompt for creating nostalgic 1990s-themed urban illustrations, mimicking screen-print and vinyl-record-sleeve aesthetics with flat colors and halftone shading.
blocks.prompt:
Create a 4:5 vertical retro urban album-art illustration built around {argument name="city block theme" default="neighborhood environment"}. Show {argument name="subject" default="a pedestrian"} naturally interacting within a nostalgic 1990s neighborhood environment. Fill the street with {argument name="street details" default="storefronts, sidewalks, and utility poles"}, arranged as believable foreground, middle-ground, and background elements without making the composition cluttered.
Use a broad city-block composition from slightly above pedestrian eye level, with strong perspective carrying the viewer through storefronts, sidewalks, brick buildings, stoops, parked objects, utility poles, and distant architecture.
Give the figures simplified cartoon-like anatomy, confident poses, expressive gestures, thick black contour lines, rhythmic motion marks, and playful hand-drawn graphic symbols.
Render the scene in {argument name="color palette" default="flat color areas"} using imperfect ink registration, faded halftone shading, rough screen-print edges, paper fibers, tiny scratches, dusty grain, and subtle vintage vinyl-record-sleeve wear.
Add loose graffiti-inspired abstract shapes and energetic marks, but no readable tags or random lettering.
The atmosphere should feel nostalgic, combining neighborhood storytelling, vintage hip-hop visual culture, analog-print character, and handmade editorial illustration.
Keep the artwork original rather than reproducing any specific artist’s identifiable composition. No logos, trademarks, signatures, watermarks, readable brand names, unintended text, borders, grids, collage panels, or photorealism.

blocks.title: No. 83: 漫画 / 故事板 - Introvert Difficulty Meme Comic
blocks.description: A four-panel cartoon meme comic showing an anxious introvert dragged from a peaceful night into a full extrovert social gauntlet.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a humorous 4-panel meme comic about {argument name="character name" default="an anxious introvert"} being forced into increasingly social situations, in a polished digital cartoon style.
Canvas: Landscape 4:3 comic page with four equal panels in a 2×2 grid, thick black gutters, warm saturated colors, expressive faces, soft evening lighting, slightly exaggerated Pixar/anime-inspired character design, clean readable speech bubbles and meme captions.
Main character: A pale, skinny young adult introvert with messy black hair, huge round anxious eyes, dark hoodie, dark plaid pajama pants or black pants depending on panel, awkward slouched posture, and a constantly overwhelmed expression. Keep the same character recognizable across all 4 panels.
Panel 1, top left: Cozy dim bedroom or apartment at night. The introvert stands alone holding a black mug labeled “LEAVE ME JUICE,” wearing gray cat slippers. Background details include a bookshelf, string lights, a beanbag or chair with a pillow that says “NO THANKS,” a framed wall sign reading “SOCIAL BATTERY 100%,” and a phone-style notification card in the foreground. Thought bubble text: “Perfect. A calm day with zero human interaction.” Notification text: “REMINDER: Team-building retreat starts now!” Bottom yellow meme caption: “introvert difficulty setting: impossible”.
Panel 2, top right: Chaotic networking or team-building party packed with smiling coworkers around the terrified introvert. Use purple party lighting, string lights, banners, confetti, drinks, name tags, and exaggerated extrovert energy. A banner in the background reads “CONNECT! COLLABORATE! COMMUNICATE!” Add background exclamations: “BLA BLA BLA!”, “HAHA!”, and “COOL!” The introvert stands in the center in a black hoodie with a red name tag that says “HELLO MY NAME IS NOPE.” A blond extrovert leans in with a huge smile and speech bubble: “Let’s go around and share a fun fact!” The introvert’s small speech bubble: “I once microwaved tea.” Include 4 visible coworker name tags: “HELLO MY NAME IS TARA,” “HELLO MY NAME IS PEOPLE PERSON,” “HELLO MY NAME IS DAVE,” and “HELLO MY NAME IS CHATTY KAT.”
Panel 3, bottom left: Karaoke scene split within the panel into two stacked moments. Top portion: the introvert hides behind a large potted plant while an excited woman in a colorful patterned shirt points at them, with a speech bubble saying “OMG you’re perfect for karaoke!” Her name tag reads “HELLO MY NAME IS SUNSHINE SUSAN.” Bottom portion: the introvert is forced on stage gripping a microphone, trembling with panic in front of a karaoke monitor. Neon purple stage lights, music notes, hearts, and a giant lyric screen reading “DON’T STOP BELIEVIN’.” The introvert’s speech bubble says: “Please do stop believin’.”
Panel 4, bottom right: Loud brunch/club afterparty atmosphere with a crowded table full of laughing friends, champagne flutes, pancakes, fruit, plates, coffee, and party lights. The introvert sits in the center, exhausted and dead-eyed in a black hoodie, with a mug labeled “SOCIAL OVERLOAD” and a skull icon. A happy person shouts in a speech bubble: “We’re all going clubbing after this!” A small ghost version of the introvert floats above, X eyes and halo, saying: “I’m freeeeee... (goodbye cruel world...)” A wall sign reads “BRUNCH IS THE NEW PRE-GAME.” Bottom black meme caption with mixed yellow and white text: “me: goes outside once” and “the universe: congratulations, you are now booked for the full extrovert experience”.
Constraints: Use exactly 4 panels. Preserve all listed text legibly. Make the humor clear through contrast between the introvert’s panic and the crowd’s enthusiasm. No watermark, no extra panels, no unrelated characters, no photorealism.

blocks.title: No. 86: 漫画 / 故事板 - Chinese Viral AI Comic Post Screenshot
blocks.description: Creates a smartphone screenshot of a Chinese social media post featuring a two-panel ancient palace AI comic with circled engagement metrics.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic screenshot of a Chinese social media post on a smartphone, showing a viral AI-generated illustrated story card about an ancient palace dancer and an emperor, with engagement metrics circled in red.
Canvas: Vertical smartphone screenshot, 9:16 aspect ratio, white app interface background, clean mobile UI. The status bar at the top shows 11:22, 4G signal, and battery icon.
Top app header: Include a back arrow on the left, a small circular female profile avatar, the account name {argument name="account name" default="菲菲_AI智能体"}, a rounded pink outline follow button labeled “关注”, and a share arrow icon on the right.
Main image post: A beige comic-style image card centered below the header, with a small dark rounded page indicator at the top-right reading “2/10”. The card contains exactly 2 stacked illustrated panels, each bordered in black, separated by large cream caption bands with bold Chinese brush-calligraphy text.
Panel 1: Ancient Chinese imperial palace scene in soft muted watercolor comic style. On the right, a stern emperor in ornate golden robes sits on a dragon-carved throne under curtains, with palace architecture behind him. In the center foreground, a graceful female dancer in pale flowing robes performs with her back partially turned. On the left, exactly 5 seated female musicians in traditional robes play instruments, including pipa and string instruments. The caption band below reads “在玉皇大帝眼中”, with “玉皇大帝” emphasized in dark red and the rest in black.
Panel 2: Frontal dramatic portrait of the same dancer standing in a palace hall, looking sad and vulnerable, wearing pale white-blue hanfu, ornate hair accessories, and delicate makeup. Behind her are exactly 2 armored palace guards, one on each side, plus a blurred group of palace women in the background. Cool blue-gray lighting creates a solemn atmosphere. The caption band below reads “她仅仅只是一名舞女”, with “舞女” emphasized in dark red and the rest in black.
Post text below image: Show a carousel dot row with exactly 5 dots, the second dot red and the other 4 light gray. Then display the Chinese caption text in two lines: “人还是原本那个人，在不同人眼里价值截然不” and “人还是原本那个人，在不同人眼里价值截然不同”. Beneath it, show hashtags in blue-gray text: “#人与人的区别 #AI教程 #AI工具 #人生的价值 #ai关键词 #提示词分享 #AI学习 #AI绘图 #AI漫画 #AI新手村”.
Bottom interaction bar: Include a rounded comment input field labeled “说点什么...”. To the right, show exactly 3 engagement items: a heart icon with {argument name="like count" default="2072"}, a star/favorite icon with {argument name="favorite count" default="876"}, and a comment bubble icon with {argument name="comment count" default="110"}. Draw a thick hand-drawn red oval around these 3 metrics only.
Visual style: The app UI should look like a real screenshot, while the embedded artwork should look like polished AI comic illustration with ink outlines, soft watercolor shading, muted palace colors, and cinematic ancient Chinese drama atmosphere.
Constraints: Keep all visible Chinese text legible and accurately placed. Do not add extra panels, extra engagement icons, watermarks, or unrelated UI elements.
blocks.author: 壹新

blocks.title: No. 89: 产品营销 - Luxury Desert Air Conditioner Advertisement
blocks.description: A high-end advertising prompt for a premium air conditioner, featuring a humorous but sophisticated scene of a camel relaxing in the desert with specialized airflow effects.
blocks.prompt: The most critical thing for this type of air conditioner advertisement is not 'coldness', but to depict the cold air as an action with a starting point, weight, and a landing point. 🧊 fan-shaped icy airflow starting dense at the vent, widening diagonally downward, diffusing softly around the subject In this way, the cold air will 'blast' out of the machine instead of being a blue special effect floating on the screen. It should be brighter and denser near the air outlet, and then soften when it lands on people or animals, making the function more persuasive. ✨ warm desert room outside the airflow, pale blue reflections only on the sofa, fur, ice, and nearby objects It solves the problem of unrealistic contrast between cold and warm. The overall environment remains hot, but only the area blown by the wind turns blue, frosts, and reflects light. The audience will naturally understand: this is a comfort zone created by the air conditioner. Create an ultra-premium advertising poster for a fictional luxury air-conditioner brand called AEROLUNE, preserving the core visual logic of a wall-mounted air conditioner overpowering extreme desert heat in a witty, high-end lifestyle campaign. The image must feel product-led, luxurious, visually striking, and Cannes-level memorable, balancing playful surrealism with flagship appliance advertising polish. Use a vertical poster layout. Place one sleek premium wall-mounted air conditioner in the upper-right quadrant, large, clean, and clearly readable, mounted against a warm desert-toned architectural backdrop. From the vent, project a powerful fan-shaped cascade of icy blue-white cooling airflow diagonally downward, with layered pressure beams, luminous cold ribbons, sparkling frost particles, chilled vapor spirals, and subtle icy turbulence. The airflow must feel stronger, denser, and more physically convincing near the vent, then elegantly diffused as it reaches the lounging subject below. The cooling stream must become the dominant visual action in the composition. In the lower-middle area, place one elegant camel reclining comfortably on a refined luxury desert sofa, posed with aristocratic calm and subtle humor. The camel should feel heat-relieved, pampered, and quietly glamorous, with realistic camel anatomy adapted into a polished commercial style: long neck raised proudly, relaxed half-closed eyes, dignified muzzle, natural leg structure, and a composed expression of premium comfort. Add restrained accessories such as refined dark sunglasses and delicate decorative tassel accents, keeping them tasteful and premium. Upgrade the seating zone into a more elevated desert-luxury hospitality setting. The sofa should feel plush and expensive, upholstered in warm sand-beige fabric with richly patterned woven throws, elevated embroidered cushions, and a slightly more curated resort-lounge silhouette. Around the sofa base, scatter translucent ice chunks, chilled crystal fragments, and subtle frost residue as visual proof of extreme cooling performance. Beside the sofa, place a small elegant side table with a premium metal coffee pot, refined tea service, dates or fruit, and one or two carefully styled decor accents. The space should feel like an exclusive desert retreat lounge rather than a simple comedic setup. Set the environment in an open desert landscape with rolling dunes fading into the distance, but integrate a more sophisticated lifestyle atmosphere: refined architectural hints, resort-like spatial order, soft premium sand texture, and a clean horizon structure. The world must remain hot and expansive, but the cooled zone beneath the air-conditioner should visibly transform into a comfort oasis. Preserve the warm-versus-cool contrast: the environment glows in controlled amber-gold, sand beige, and muted desert ochre, while the air stream introduces icy cyan, frosted white, silver-blue, and cool luminous highlights. Lighting must be cinematic and highly controlled. Use warm desert sunlight as the environmental ambient light, but let the air-conditioner stream generate its own cool illumination, casting pale blue reflections onto the camel, sofa, fabrics, ice, metallic objects, and nearby sand. Keep the overall warmth slightly more restrained and premium, shifting the desert palette toward sophisticated amber-gold, gray-sand, and muted bronze rather than oversaturated yellow. The cool zone must feel cleaner, sharper, and more luxurious, with soft premium shadows and no muddy darkness. Render all materials with exceptional realism: matte-white air-conditioner housing, precise vent detailing, dense silky airflow, soft camel fur, woven upholstery, embroidered textile surfaces, polished metal tea set, crystalline ice, subtle sand granularity, and faint local frost where the cold air lands most strongly. The airflow must feel physically coherent and elegant, never like cheap fantasy smoke. Camel anatomy must remain correct and believable. The scene should feel surreal only in concept, not in rendering quality. Preserve the graphic logic of a bold advertisement headline on the left side of the composition, but use fully original fictional copy only. Add a large stacked headline in a strong premium display style, for example: “WHEN THE DESERT BURNS, WE STAY GLACIAL.” Then add a smaller original supporting line beneath it, such as: “AEROLUNE signature cooling for extreme climates” Keep all typography integrated, sparse, clean, and brand-level. Add a tiny original legal/disclaimer-style line near the bottom edge if needed. Do not copy any wording or brand from the reference. Color palette: amber gold, muted sand beige, desert bronze, camel tan, icy cyan, frosted white, silver-blue, soft charcoal accents. Keep the warm world broad and atmospheric, while the cool airflow becomes the sharp visual force that defines the ad. The final image must feel like a world-class appliance flagship campaign poster: product-dominant, witty, luxurious, clean, physically believable, and unforgettable. Negative prompt: real brand names, copied slogan text, copied typography, watermark, signature, broken camel anatomy, distorted legs, malformed face, extra limbs, fake airflow, messy frost, cheap cartoon look, muddy lighting, cluttered props, black blotches, low resolution, unreadable text, weak product dominance

The burger should be shot straight-on at eye level with a square crop, filling most of the image. Show a glossy toasted brioche top bun with rich golden-brown shine and subtle texture, a layer of creamy orange speckled sauce dripping slightly under the top bun, exactly 5 visible crinkle-cut pickle slices in a row, one folded slice of melted American cheese, a thick oversized golden-orange crispy fried chicken fillet with highly detailed crunchy breading, shredded iceberg lettuce, more creamy orange sauce, and a glossy toasted brioche bottom bun. Use appetizing commercial food photography lighting with soft shadows, crisp focus, realistic textures, vibrant warm colors, and no text, logo, plate, hands, props, or watermark.

blocks.title: No. 91: 产品营销 - Smartphone Livestream Peacock Poster
blocks.description: A professional tech advertising prompt for a smartphone launch, using a colorful peacock in a fantasy garden to demonstrate color reproduction and livestreaming quality.
blocks.prompt: 制作一张超高端垂直智能手机广告海报，采用精致的风格化 3D 动画风格，围绕明亮户外幻想花园中旗舰级直播色彩忠实度的理念展开。画面必须充满愉悦感、电影感、精致感，并具有国际化的高级质感，如同虚构高端智能手机品牌的世界级发布海报。保持智能手机作为绝对的商业主角，而一只壮丽的孔雀则作为丰富色彩还原和直播清晰度的生动证明。核心构图：使用高大的垂直海报布局。在左下方到左中前景，放置一台安装在紧凑金属三脚架上的高端智能手机，位置稍靠近观众，使其成为最清晰的主角物体。手机背面必须面向观众，屏幕必须面向孔雀，清晰地表明手机正在拍摄或直播这只鸟。后置摄像头系统必须完全可见，并感觉像是一个关键卖点。在画面右中心，放置一只优雅的风格化孔雀，自豪地站立，尾巴完全展开成巨大的辐射状扇形。孔雀必须高度可辨、优雅且视觉壮观，但在层级上仍次于手机。展开的尾巴应填满中心和右上区域的大部分，成为生动直播色彩细节的完美视觉体现。轨道增强型产品主导地位：在透视上将智能手机略微前移，锐化其轮廓，使三脚架感觉居中、稳定且经过精心布置。观众应先看到设备，然后是后置摄像头模块，最后是孔雀。保持下方构图简洁，使手机、三脚架和孔雀形成一个强大的商业三角。摄像头模块必须捕捉到精致的高级高光，使直播能力立即具有说服力。氛围增强：将整体氛围推向更简洁、更冷色调、更具国际旗舰科技感的格调。将花园调色板从过于温暖的卡通阳光转向清新的天空蓝、蓝绿色叶子、珍珠银高光和更清晰的大气深度。保持画面明亮诱人，但减少过多的金色暖色，使最终效果更具高级感、更全球化、更具技术前瞻性。风格和视觉语言：超细节风格化 3D 动画，旗舰商业 CG 广告，高端角色驱动的科技营销活动，精致的户外产品海报，电影深度，优雅愉悦的奢华感，世界级广告水准。孔雀设计与解剖：设计一只完全原创的风格化孔雀，具有优雅的解剖结构、细长的脖子、富有表现力的面部、自豪挺拔的姿态、精致的冠羽和渲染极其精细的完全展开的尾巴。羽毛必须感觉丰富、分层且在高级动画风格中显得真实，具有精心结构的羽眼，呈现虹彩色钴蓝、祖母绿、绿松石色和微妙的青铜色点缀。鸟儿必须自然地站在草地上，具有连贯的腿部解剖、正确的爪子位置和优雅的身体平衡。如果需要，可以添加微妙的装饰性项圈，但必须保持优雅克制。产品设计：设计一款完全原创的高端智能手机，具有精致的珍珠白至冷银色背板，圆润光滑的边角，纤细的机身，优雅的后置摄像头模块，以及微妙的高级表面光泽。由于设备正在直播孔雀，后置摄像头系统必须特别清晰、精美且令人向往。手机必须看起来现代、昂贵且达到旗舰级别。在左上角添加完全原创的虚构品牌和型号标识，例如“AURALIS Nova V1 Pro”，不与任何真实品牌雷同。文字布局与广告排版：保留真实智能手机发布海报的逻辑。在左上角区域，放置简洁的原创英文型号行，随后是堆叠布局的大号粗体中文标题，例如：“原彩高还原 / 所见即所得”，下方是较小的中文辅助行，描述虚构的直播和色彩成像优势。在底部，添加原创的发布日期和时间行，以及一小块精细打印的免责声明文字。所有措辞必须完全原创、简洁、高端且排版精美。光照：使用来自左上方的柔和高级日光，带有精致的电影光晕，在手机边缘、后置摄像头模块、三脚架、孔雀脖子和羽扇上创造温柔的高光。从花园环境中添加微妙的环境填充光，使孔雀羽毛在没有强烈对比的情况下保持丰富的可读性。保持手机清晰且具高级感，带有洁净的银白色反射。光照必须感觉通风、乐观、精致且具备旗舰水准。环境与空间：场景设置在明亮优雅的花园或类似野生动物公园的草坪上，带有柔和的棕榈剪影、远处的绿意、温暖的石头和在电影背景虚化中呈现的温柔花卉点缀。保持环境开放、透气且不凌乱，具有清晰的左上文字区和稳定的下方信息区。设置必须支持孔雀的色彩丰富性，同时不与手机竞争。材质渲染：智能手机必须感觉具有金属感、光滑且工艺精湛，具有抛光的后置镜头玻璃、柔软的珍珠色反射和高级工业设计。三脚架必须感觉轻便但稳定，具有金属管和真实的关节。孔雀羽毛必须感觉分层、丝滑、虹彩且高度详细，具有可信的纹理过渡和柔和的自然光泽。草地、石头和树叶必须感觉具有触感且高端，没有廉价的塑料感。色彩系统：围绕干净的天空蓝、清新的花园绿、孔雀钴蓝、祖母绿、绿松石色、克制的青铜点缀、珍珠白设备色调和柔和的阳光中性色构建图像。保持色调生动但受控，比典型的温馨家庭动画海报更冷、更清晰。情感基调应感觉明亮、优雅、活泼且技术自信。图像质量与物理约束：极致细节，清晰的产品轮廓，可读的文字层级，连贯的风格化鸟类解剖，无畸形的爪子，无破损的羽毛逻辑，无扭曲的三脚架，无泥泞的阴影，无黑色斑块，无杂乱的背景，无弱化的产品层级。最终结果必须感觉像世界级的动画智能手机营销海报：以产品为导向、色彩丰富、支持直播且完全具备商业部署能力。负面提示：真实品牌名称，复制的广告文本，复制的中文标题，水印，签名，破碎的解剖结构，畸形的鸟脸，错误的爪子解剖，羽毛变形，塑料感羽毛，廉价的 CG 感，低细节智能手机，扭曲的三脚架，杂乱的背景，泥泞的光照，黑色斑块，无法阅读的排版，低分辨率，混乱的构图

动画风格，围绕明亮户外幻想花园中旗舰级直播色彩忠实度的理念展开。画面必须充满愉悦感、电影感、精致感，并具有国际化的高级质感，如同虚构高端智能手机品牌的世界级发布海报。保持智能手机作为绝对的商业主角，而一只壮丽的孔雀则作为丰富色彩还原和直播清晰度的生动证明。核心构图：使用高大的垂直海报布局。在左下方到左中前景，放置一台安装在紧凑金属三脚架上的高端智能手机，位置稍靠近观众，使其成为最清晰的主角物体。手机背面必须面向观众，屏幕必须面向孔雀，清晰地表明手机正在拍摄或直播这只鸟。后置摄像头系统必须完全可见，并感觉像是一个关键卖点。在画面右中心，放置一只优雅的风格化孔雀，自豪地站立，尾巴完全展开成巨大的辐射状扇形。孔雀必须高度可辨、优雅且视觉壮观，但在层级上仍次于手机。展开的尾巴应填满中心和右上区域的大部分，成为生动直播色彩细节的完美视觉体现。轨道增强型产品主导地位：在透视上将智能手机略微前移，锐化其轮廓，使三脚架感觉居中、稳定且经过精心布置。观众应先看到设备，然后是后置摄像头模块，最后是孔雀。保持下方构图简洁，使手机、三脚架和孔雀形成一个强大的商业三角。摄像头模块必须捕捉到精致的高级高光，使直播能力立即具有说服力。氛围增强：将整体氛围推向更简洁、更冷色调、更具国际旗舰科技感的格调。将花园调色板从过于温暖的卡通阳光转向清新的天空蓝、蓝绿色叶子、珍珠银高光和更清晰的大气深度。保持画面明亮诱人，但减少过多的金色暖色，使最终效果更具高级感、更全球化、更具技术前瞻性。风格和视觉语言：超细节风格化 3D 动画，旗舰商业 CG 广告，高端角色驱动的科技营销活动，精致的户外产品海报，电影深度，优雅愉悦的奢华感，世界级广告水准。孔雀设计与解剖：设计一只完全原创的风格化孔雀，具有优雅的解剖结构、细长的脖子、富有表现力的面部、自豪挺拔的姿态、精致的冠羽和渲染极其精细的完全展开的尾巴。羽毛必须感觉丰富、分层且在高级动画风格中显得真实，具有精心结构的羽眼，呈现虹彩色钴蓝、祖母绿、绿松石色和微妙的青铜色点缀。鸟儿必须自然地站在草地上，具有连贯的腿部解剖、正确的爪子位置和优雅的身体平衡。如果需要，可以添加微妙的装饰性项圈，但必须保持优雅克制。产品设计：设计一款完全原创的高端智能手机，具有精致的珍珠白至冷银色背板，圆润光滑的边角，纤细的机身，优雅的后置摄像头模块，以及微妙的高级表面光泽。由于设备正在直播孔雀，后置摄像头系统必须特别清晰、精美且令人向往。手机必须看起来现代、昂贵且达到旗舰级别。在左上角添加完全原创的虚构品牌和型号标识，例如“AURALIS Nova V1 Pro”，不与任何真实品牌雷同。文字布局与广告排版：保留真实智能手机发布海报的逻辑。在左上角区域，放置简洁的原创英文型号行，随后是堆叠布局的大号粗体中文标题，例如：“原彩高还原 / 所见即所得”，下方是较小的中文辅助行，描述虚构的直播和色彩成像优势。在底部，添加原创的发布日期和时间行，以及一小块精细打印的免责声明文字。所有措辞必须完全原创、简洁、高端且排版精美。光照：使用来自左上方的柔和高级日光，带有精致的电影光晕，在手机边缘、后置摄像头模块、三脚架、孔雀脖子和羽扇上创造温柔的高光。从花园环境中添加微妙的环境填充光，使孔雀羽毛在没有强烈对比的情况下保持丰富的可读性。保持手机清晰且具高级感，带有洁净的银白色反射。光照必须感觉通风、乐观、精致且具备旗舰水准。环境与空间：场景设置在明亮优雅的花园或类似野生动物公园的草坪上，带有柔和的棕榈剪影、远处的绿意、温暖的石头和在电影背景虚化中呈现的温柔花卉点缀。保持环境开放、透气且不凌乱，具有清晰的左上文字区和稳定的下方信息区。设置必须支持孔雀的色彩丰富性，同时不与手机竞争。材质渲染：智能手机必须感觉具有金属感、光滑且工艺精湛，具有抛光的后置镜头玻璃、柔软的珍珠色反射和高级工业设计。三脚架必须感觉轻便但稳定，具有金属管和真实的关节。孔雀羽毛必须感觉分层、丝滑、虹彩且高度详细，具有可信的纹理过渡和柔和的自然光泽。草地、石头和树叶必须感觉具有触感且高端，没有廉价的塑料感。色彩系统：围绕干净的天空蓝、清新的花园绿、孔雀钴蓝、祖母绿、绿松石色、克制的青铜点缀、珍珠白设备色调和柔和的阳光中性色构建图像。保持色调生动但受控，比典型的温馨家庭动画海报更冷、更清晰。情感基调应感觉明亮、优雅、活泼且技术自信。图像质量与物理约束：极致细节，清晰的产品轮廓，可读的文字层级，连贯的风格化鸟类解剖，无畸形的爪子，无破损的羽毛逻辑，无扭曲的三脚架，无泥泞的阴影，无黑色斑块，无杂乱的背景，无弱化的产品层级。最终结果必须感觉像世界级的动画智能手机营销海报：以产品为导向、色彩丰富、支持直播且完全具备商业部署能力。负面提示：真实品牌名称，复制的广告文本，复制的中文标题，水印，签名，破碎的解剖结构，畸形的鸟脸，错误的爪子解剖，羽毛变形，塑料感羽毛，廉价的 CG 感，低细节智能手机，扭曲的三脚架，杂乱的背景，泥泞的光照，黑色斑块，无法阅读的排版，低分辨率，混乱的构图

blocks.title: No. 92: 产品营销 - Futuristic Mall Fashion Scene
blocks.description: A photorealistic cinematic prompt for generating a luxury cyberpunk shopping mall in 3050 with a futuristic fashion model and holographic signage.
blocks.prompt: Create a cinematic ultra-realistic wide-angle scene of a futuristic luxury shopping mall in the year {argument name="year" default="3050"}, viewed at eye level from the center of a glossy marble concourse. A young East Asian woman is walking directly toward the camera as the main subject, centered and sharply in focus, with long slightly windblown black hair, pale skin, natural makeup, and a calm confident expression. She wears a high-fashion transparent iridescent cyber outfit: clear glossy trench coat, metallic silver cropped top, harness straps with small buckles, high-waisted reflective pants, translucent sleeves, and tech accessories in a white-silver palette. Surround her with a busy crowd of fashionable mall visitors wearing futuristic streetwear in black, white, chrome, and transparent materials; people walk in both directions, with some figures softly blurred by depth of field. The mall architecture is enormous and vertical, with multiple stacked glass balconies, luxury storefronts, curved LED light strips, mirrored walls, and a wet-looking reflective floor. Add many blue holographic advertisements and signage throughout the scene, including readable signs such as "ELEVATE", "CYBERDECK", "3050", "NEW ERA", and "NEW HUMAN" on cylindrical hologram pillars and shop facades. Lighting should be cool blue-white, high contrast, with reflections, lens glow, neon accents, and a polished cyberpunk fashion editorial mood. Composition: 16:9 horizontal image, central vanishing point, symmetrical futuristic mall corridor, the model full-body to three-quarter body in the foreground, background packed with depth and detail. Style: photorealistic, high-resolution, cinematic, luxury sci-fi, realistic faces and fabric materials, no cartoon look, no watermark, no extra random text beyond the mall signage. Customize the main subject as {argument name="main subject" default="young East Asian woman"}, the outfit palette as {argument name="outfit palette" default="transparent iridescent silver and white"}, and the mall brand mood as {argument name="mall brand mood" default="luxury cyberpunk fashion"}.

blocks.title: No. 93: 产品营销 - Japanese Glamour Typography Poster
blocks.description: Generates a realistic studio portrait poster with bold distressed Japanese typography for an editorial fan-art or magazine-cover style image.
blocks.prompt: Create a clean editorial poster portrait of a beautiful Japanese woman, {argument name="character name" default="Anri Okita"}, standing centered against an off-white studio background, facing the camera with a soft confident smile. She has shoulder-length wavy dark brown hair parted to one side, pale luminous skin, subtle natural makeup, small hoop earrings, and a delicate necklace with a tiny circular pendant. She wears a ribbed dusty-rose camisole with thin straps and high-waisted light beige jeans, hands held behind her back, cropped from head to upper thighs. Use a mostly monochrome black-and-white photographic look with only the camisole softly colorized in muted rose and the jeans lightly warm beige. Behind her, place oversized bold Japanese typography in distressed black ink: exactly 4 large visible characters total, with one giant brush-calligraphy character on the left reading {argument name="left calligraphy character" default="沖"}, two huge block characters on the right reading {argument name="right top and bottom characters" default="田 杏梨"}, and one small printed signature at bottom left reading {argument name="small signature text" default="沖田"}. The typography should be partially hidden behind the figure, with rough ink texture, grunge speckles, and strong graphic contrast. Composition: square 4:3-ish poster crop, minimal background, sharp realistic portrait lighting, high-end magazine cover aesthetic, no extra props, no watermark, no additional text.

blocks.title: No. 94: 产品营销 - Rose-Pink Studio Fashion Portrait
blocks.description: Creates a romantic, photorealistic studio portrait with a monochromatic rose-pink theme and a cocoa-brown background.
blocks.prompt:
Create a photorealistic vertical 4:5 studio-fashion portrait of a glamorous adult woman reclining sideways across a large low white circular platform. She wears a monochromatic {argument name="outfit color" default="pale rose-pink"} ensemble consisting of a fitted sleeveless crew-neck top, matching wide-leg trousers, and a soft draped wrap panel gathered around the waist and hips. Silver rhinestone open-toe sandals finish the look.
Arrange multiple long-stem pale-pink roses radially across the front half of the platform, with their green stems pointing inward and their blossoms hanging over or resting near the curved front edge.
Support the woman’s upper body with one straight planted arm at viewer-left. Her opposite elbow bends upward, with the fingers resting softly beneath her chin. Her hips and folded legs extend toward viewer-right, ending in layered silver sandals near the platform’s outer edge. Turn her face toward viewer-right and direct her eyes upward into the open negative space.
Place the set against a seamless warm {argument name="background color" default="cocoa-brown"} studio background with abundant empty space above and to viewer-right. Use broad, polished studio illumination with soft directional modeling, clean fabric detail, gentle contact shadows, controlled skin texture, and a warm editorial finish.
The final photograph should feel like a romantic independent beauty-studio portrait: feminine, composed, softly theatrical, floral, slightly formal, and physically grounded—not a bedroom scene, bridal portrait, flower field, or luxury campaign composite.
blocks.author: Rouge Halo Productions

blocks.title: No. 95: 产品营销 - Surreal Macro Fashion Illusion
blocks.description: A surreal fashion carousel prompt featuring a miniature person standing on a finger, utilizing scale illusions and macro photography.
blocks.prompt: Creative fashion carousel cover, vertical 3:4, surreal scale illusion, ultra photoreal macro photography. Extreme close-up macro shot filling the frame: the chest of a person in {argument name="attire style" default="old money attire"} - {argument name="clothing details" default="crisp white oxford shirt, navy grenadine silk tie with a vintage gold tie bar, herringbone tweed blazer lapel on the right edge"} - and their hand raised in front of the tie, fingers relaxed, wearing a {argument name="accessory" default="gold signet ring on the pinky"}. Standing casually on top of the bent index finger: a tiny miniature version of the same person from the reference image, about as tall as two fingernails stacked, looking straight at the camera, both hands in pockets. The miniature wears a different old money outfit: camel overcoat over a cream turtleneck, brown pleated trousers, suede loafers. Both the giant chest and the tiny figure are the same person and the tiny figure's face matches the reference image exactly. Contrasty side lighting on the tiny figure's face. Sharp macro focus on the tie texture, tie bar and the tiny figure, soft falloff to a blurred cream townhouse background. Realistic contact shadow of the tiny figure on the finger skin. Natural daylight, muted editorial colors, shot on iphone macro, fashion carousel aesthetic.

blocks.title: No. 96: 产品营销 - Transparent Earbuds on Stone Pedestal
blocks.description: A cinematic minimalist product photo prompt for showcasing transparent wireless earbuds with premium industrial design against rugged stone.
blocks.prompt: Create a high-end minimalist product photograph of {argument name="product" default="Nothing transparent wireless earbuds in a clear square charging case"} balanced diagonally on top of a rough stacked stone pedestal. The scene is vertical 3:4, centered composition, with the transparent rounded-square case floating or lightly resting at a 35-degree tilt above the rock. Inside the case are exactly 2 visible earbuds, one near the upper right and one near the lower left, with glossy black and metallic internal components, clear stems, and white translucent ear tips; the case has visible hinges, seams, rounded corners, and a small subtle wordmark reading “NOTHING” on the inner surface. The pedestal consists of exactly 2 large rugged stone blocks: a taller light-gray upper rock with sharp texture and a darker wider lower rock beneath it, both dramatically lit from the upper left so the right side falls into deep shadow. Use {argument name="background color" default="soft smoky gray"} studio backdrop with a gentle vignette, grainy atmospheric haze, and no visible horizon line. Lighting should be cinematic and directional, emphasizing contrast between the sleek transparent electronics and the primitive stone texture, with crisp highlights on plastic edges, soft shadows, realistic reflections, shallow depth of field, and premium industrial design aesthetics inspired by Nothing. No extra objects, no hands, no packaging, no large typography, no watermark.

blocks.title: No. 97: 产品营销 - Wet Transparent Earbud Macro
blocks.description: A premium hyper-realistic macro product shot of a futuristic transparent earbud covered in water droplets for tech advertising visuals.
blocks.prompt: Create a hyper-realistic macro product photograph of a single futuristic transparent earbud, centered vertically against a soft light gray studio background. The earbud has a glossy black inner body with a clear acrylic outer shell wrapping around it, shaped like a long rounded stem attached to an oval earbud head. Include one white silicone ear tip behind the head, slightly out of focus and angled to the right, and one rounded white outer disk behind the black oval face. Add two small perforated silver speaker-grille plates: one near the upper-left area of the head and one near the bottom of the stem. Add exactly one bright red circular button on the upper-right side of the black face. Cover the entire object with many realistic water droplets of varied sizes, including beads on the clear casing, black face, and white silicone parts. Lighting should be cool, diffused, and high-contrast enough to show reflections, refraction through the transparent plastic, fine ridges along the clear shell, and tiny droplets. Use shallow depth of field, premium tech product advertising style, sharp focus on the front earbud surface, no text, no logo, no hands, no extra objects.

blocks.title: No. 99: 电商主图 - Premium Energy Drink Branding Concepts
blocks.description: A detailed product design prompt for transforming a logo into a futuristic energy drink brand board, featuring realistic textures and lighting.
blocks.prompt:
{argument name="brand name" default="[BRAND NAME]"} → Premium Energy Drink Concept
Transform {argument name="brand name" default="[BRAND NAME]"} into a futuristic, premium energy drink brand using its existing logo, colors, typography, shapes, proportions, and visual personality as the core creative DNA.

The left sculpture is transparent clear glass with thick rounded edges, visible refraction, caustic highlights, and subtle internal reflections. The right sculpture is white marble with soft gray veining, matte-satin stone texture, and rounded carved edges. All three objects have identical continuous Möbius-like figure-eight forms with an open oval hole at the top and bottom, standing vertically and casting soft shadows plus faint floor reflections. Use a minimalist warm-gray studio background with blurred rectangular softbox light reflections on the left and right walls, diffuse natural lighting, shallow depth of field, centered symmetrical composition, high-end luxury material study, no text, no people, no watermark. blocks.title: No. 109: 电商主图 - Traditional Stewed Pear Dessert Poster
blocks.description: A detailed macro photography prompt for a Chinese-style dessert poster featuring snow pears in a glass pot with warm morning light and elegant typography.
blocks.prompt: A transparent glass spoon scoops a piece of translucent snow pear from a stewing pot, with clear syrup forming a small backflow along the tip of the spoon. Design a 3:4 vertical rock sugar stewed pear poster for an original nourishing dessert brand "{argument name="brand name" default="Pear Stewed Slowly"}". The scene is set exclusively on a warm white stone window sill on an autumn morning. A 15cm diameter transparent heat-resistant glass stewing pot is placed slightly to the right of the center, with the glass lid lying flat to the back left. The pot is 70% full of clear light-gold syrup, precisely containing eight pieces of cut snow pear, six pieces of transparent rock sugar, and three dried osmanthus flowers. A transparent glass spoon scoops a piece of pear from the right, stopping about 4cm above the rim of the pot, with the syrup backflow controlled at 3cm. The center of the pot is at 62% horizontal and 64% vertical, occupying about 38% of the frame width. The area from 7% to 42% horizontal and 9% to 47% vertical on the left remains a warm white text zone. The foreground contains only half a fresh snow pear with the cut side facing up, while the background features a soft white sheer curtain; do not add red dates, wolfberries, or tremella. The camera is 12cm above the middle of the pot, using a 90mm macro lens shooting from the front left at a 14-degree angle from a distance of 72cm. The focus is locked on the pear fibers in the spoon, the transparency of the syrup, and the edge of the glass pot, with the lid remaining recognizable. A large window-shaped soft light of about 5500K from the back left penetrates the syrup and pear meat, while a warm white reflector at the front right restores the glass contours. Two strands of very faint steam rise towards the window. The color scheme is 52% warm white background, 18% transparent light-gold syrup, 20% pear milk white, 5% glass gray, and 5% dark brown text. Pear meat should be soft and slightly translucent but retain its chunk shape; syrup should be clear and low-viscosity, not a thick jam or milky soup. Text is limited to brand name "{argument name="brand name" default="Pear Stewed Slowly"}", product name "{argument name="product name" default="Rock Sugar Stewed Pear"}", main copy "{argument name="main copy" default="Pear fragrance stewed slowly, sweetness falls clearly"}", and English sub-title "ROCK SUGAR STEWED PEAR". The main text on the left uses a dark brown fine Song font in three lines, brand name at the top, product name and English at bottom left. Lock one pot, one lid, eight pear chunks, six rock sugar pieces, three osmanthus flowers, one glass spoon, and back-left window light; do not add herbs, a second pot, excessive condensation, thick steam, or floating pear chunks.

blocks.title: No. 110: 电商主图 - Mesh Top and Checkered Skirt Outfit
blocks.description: A highly technical fashion generation prompt for a classical girlie look, detailing the fabric textures, seams, and construction of a mesh knit crop top and a checkered A-line mini skirt.
blocks.prompt: Wardrobe: Top: One solid muted cocoa-taupe sleeveless mock-neck crop top made from a fine-gauge stretch mesh knit with tightly regular micro-openings, a lightweight semi-sheer section, a smooth low-luster face, soft close drape, and resilient multidirectional recovery. Cut a close straight-to-lightly-tapered body ending at the upper waist, with matching front and rear lower-edge levels and minimal bulk. Form a narrow circular self-fabric mock neck whose finished height is between one-tenth and one-sixth of the shoulder-to-hem length, using a double-layer return and one low-bulk rear join. Continue two narrow shoulder sections into high-cut sleeveless armholes and uninterrupted front and rear body panels. Finish both armhole circuits with narrow self-fabric turned bindings less than one-tenth of the shoulder-section width, join the body through two clean side seams, and complete the lower circumference with one narrow straight double-turn hem. Use the knit recovery and complete neck opening for a pull-on construction without exterior fastening. Keep the mesh scale evenly legible, the semi-sheer density consistent, the mock neck softly upright, the armhole edges flat, and the lower hem free of heavy opaque bulk. Bottom: One camel-tan wrap-front mini skirt made from medium-weight brushed twill with a compact diagonal weave, a short soft nap, a matte low-luster surface, firm shape retention, and rounded low-bulk folds; confine espresso brown, ivory, and muted dusty-rose to the woven geometric check and matte black to two front buttons. Cut a high-rise upper-thigh mini length with a close waist and upper hip, then widen gently into a compact A-line hem whose laid-flat width is between one-and-one-fifth and one-and-two-fifths of the top-edge width. Form a clean curved faced upper edge without a separate exterior waistband. Build smooth front and rear bodies with two equal rear waist darts, one at product-right and one at product-left, two side seams, and one full-height product-left front overlap panel spanning between one-half and two-thirds of the front width; keep its vertical free edge straight from the top edge to the hem and its underlap continuous behind it. Cover every front, overlap, side, and rear panel with a woven repeat of large upright camel rectangles bounded by single espresso lines and paired ivory lines, then add one fine dusty-rose pinstripe only to alternating vertical and horizontal corridors so the rose intersections shift by one cell on every second row; each complete repeat spans between one-quarter and one-third of the laid-flat front width, with straight orthogonal lines and clean registration across darts, seams, and the overlap. Mount two circular matte-black four-hole buttons in one vertical product-left-front line, each between one-tenth and one-eighth of the waist-to-hem depth in diameter; place the upper station within the upper quarter of that depth and the lower station between one-half and two-thirds of the depth. Secure the overlap through two matching reinforced buttonholes on the underlap, keeping both stations fully engaged and the panel flat, and finish the complete lower edge with one narrow turned hem. Preserve the short brushed nap, readable diagonal weave, crisp A-line outline, stable overlap depth, aligned geometric repeat, flat button seating, and material-correct hem thickness. Footwear: One matching pair of predominantly black combat boots built from medium-thick semi-matte coated leather-like upper material with a fine shallow grain and broad flexible crease response, black flat woven cord, silver-tone metal, and deep black molded rubber. Each boot is knee-high with a tall straight shaft, a broad rounded toe, a substantial forefoot platform, and a slightly deeper rear block, with shaft volume remaining open and stable near the top before compressing into broad slouch folds through the lower shaft and ankle. A wide straight topline forms the shaft opening and retains a clean finished edge. The upper consists of tall side and rear shaft panels joined to a rounded forefoot, broad vamp, quarters, and a central tongue; the vamp stays close while the shaft carries relaxed vertical volume. Paired rows of black lace holes run from the forefoot into the lower shaft and hold flat black laces, while two separate narrow wrap straps encircle each boot, one near the upper shaft and one at the ankle, each ending at its own compact rectangular silver-tone buckle. Tonal topstitching defines the panel joins, and the sole forms a thick continuous sidewall above a deeply cut lugged contact face. The laces close in compact tied bows and both buckle straps remain fastened through their rectangular frames. Both boots are identical anatomical mirror counterparts with the same panel layout, lace path, strap count, buckle placement, shaft height, slouch distribution, toe shape, and sole stack. Preserve the coated fine grain through the broad folds, keep the two buckle circuits physically separate from the lace closure, and maintain crisp sole edges, deep lug relief, firm toe volume, and material-correct seam bulk. Bag: Styling — highest priority: - Bag carry: Hang the strap from the wearer-right shoulder only without crossing the chest, and let the bag body lie flat along the right flank between the lower ribs and outer hip. Let the strap bear the full weight and keep both hands off the bag and strap. Keep the complete strap and bag body entirely outside and visibly separate from every garment, routing the strap over, never beneath or through, the outermost clothing. blocks.title: No. 114: 电商主图 - Pinstriped Button-Up Shirt Design
blocks.description: A highly technical fashion prompt detailing the construction, styling, and embroidery of a cropped pinstriped shirt with rolled sleeves and botanical threadwork.
blocks.prompt: ワードローブ： トップス： スタイリング： - フロントクロージャー：フロント中央のクロージャーの上部約3分の1だけを開け、胸より下のクロージャーはすべて裾まで留めたままにする。上部の開口部は左右対称に保つ。開口部を下部まで広げたり、上部を閉じ直したりしない。 - 袖：各袖口を外側にちょうど2回折り返し、両腕にダブルロールのバンドを作る。両方のバンドを前腕の中ほど、肘の折り目より下で手首より上の位置に配置する。他のスタイリング指示で衣服が肩から下がった場合でも、この巻き数と高さを維持する。袖を肘まで押し上げたり、袖口を隠したりしない。 - 仕上げ — ナチュラル： - フロントクロージャー：選択した上部開口部のみを外し、下の留め具はすべて留めたままにする。その間隔を変更せず、固定された留め状態に隣接するパネルのドレープのみを調整する。 - 袖：選択した数、位置、向き、レイヤー順序を変更しない。固定された袖の高さより下のロール構造のみを調整し、元の袖口を保持する。適度な重なりとわずかな非対称性を持つ柔らかい折り目を使用する。 淡いスカイブルーと白の垂直ピンストライプの長袖クロップドボタンアップシャツ。軽量なポプリン風の織物で、パリッとしたマットな質感。ボクシーなシルエットで、ウエストより上で終わる裾を持つ。白いポインテッドカラーと、小さな白いボタンが並ぶフロント前立てを備える。袖山に軽いギャザーがあり、広いピンストライプのバレルカフスはボタンで閉じられている。左胸にパッチポケットがあり、全体に白い植物風の刺繍やオープンワークが施されている。左胸ポケットには、半透明の花びらのアップリケやビーズを用いた立体的な装飾が集中している。ジッパーや余計な装飾のない、一貫したデザインのシャツである。 ボトムス：淡いクールグレーのハイライズフレアミニスカート。中重量のコンパクトなポンチニット製で、マットな質感。太もも上部丈のスケーターシルエット。伸縮性のあるアッパーバンドを備え、複数のパネルとシームラインで構成されている。ポケットやジッパーのないプルオンタイプで、素材の厚みと放射状のフレアを維持している。 レッグウェア：温かみのある白のショートクルーソックス。上質な垂直リブニット製で、左右対称の設計。リブ編みのアッパーカフと補強されたかかと・つま先を持ち、装飾のないシンプルなデザイン。適度な不透明度とストレッチ性を備えている。 フットウェア：温かみのあるアイボリーのロートップチャンキーレザースニーカー。丸いつま先と厚いプラットフォームソールが特徴。アッパーはスエード調の素材とオフホワイトのメッシュを組み合わせ、幾何学的なオーバーレイを配置。オフホワイトの靴紐が左右対称に通されている。頑丈なラグトレッドを備えた厚底ソールを持ち、細部まで一貫した配色と質感で仕上げられている。 バッグ： スタイリング： - バッグの持ち方：ストラップを左肩からのみ下げ、バッグ本体を左脇腹に置く。胸を横切らせず、手は添えない。バッグとストラップは衣服の外側に完全に露出させ、衣服の下や中を通さないこと。 - 仕上げ — ナチュラル：選択したストラップのルートに沿って、素材に忠実な緩みと体への接触のみを調整する。選択したルートとすべての取り付けを維持する。

blocks.title: No. 8: 个人资料 / 头像 - Night Resort Pool Side Portrait

blocks.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Turning back in the night blue"}
Main Subject:
A single adult woman sitting by a {argument name="location" default="night pool at a tropical resort"}. A night portrait from the head to below the waist, wearing {argument name="attire" default="a gray thin-strap bikini"}, showing her back in the lower center of the screen while looking back at the camera.

A slightly slender oval face with a small chin, light brown almond-shaped eyes, thin natural eyebrows, a small nose, and glossy coral-pink lips. A deep blue rectangular pool occupies most of the frame, with underwater lighting and warm lights reflecting off fine ripples. In the background are a wooden deck, lined lounge chairs, closed parasols, a wooden pergola, tall palms, and dense greenery. Vertical warm-colored lights are scattered across the black night sky. A soft warm flash near the camera serves as the main light on the subject, keeping the background dark while adding blue reflected light from the pool to her silhouette.

3:4 vertical. A close-up portrait taken from a rear-diagonal angle, slightly looking down from a camera position higher than the seated subject's shoulders. Focus is on the face and back, while the chairs and greenery in the distance are blurred with a shallow depth of field.

High-definition photorealistic night photography. Precisely depicts wet skin, gray swimsuit fabric, long hair, stone floors, the blue water surface, and warm reflections. A quiet, high-quality resort night with strong contrast between deep blue, black, and amber.

blocks.title: No. 35: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Beethoven Sonata DSD 256 Collage
blocks.description: A cinematic historical-to-futuristic music collage visualizing Beethoven's sonata performance transformed by modern DSD 256 audio.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic widescreen digital collage about Beethoven's Violin Sonata Op. 96 being rediscovered through modern high-resolution audio, blending a 19th-century Viennese salon performance with a futuristic DSD listening studio.
Canvas: 16:9 horizontal composition, dark dramatic chiaroscuro, ultra-detailed, painterly realism mixed with cybernetic audio visualization. The image should read left-to-right as a transformation from old classical performance to modern digital sound.
Layout: Split the scene into two connected halves with no hard border. Left half is a warm amber-brown historical oil-painting scene inside an ornate Viennese salon. Right half is a cool blue-black futuristic audiophile studio. A single horizontal audio waveform runs across the entire center of the image, starting as gold on the historical side and shifting into white, cyan, orange, magenta, and blue on the digital side.
Historical left side: Show exactly 2 main historical men in the foreground: 1 famous violinist in black formal 19th-century clothing playing a violin with a languid, tired expression, and 1 intense curly-haired Beethoven-like composer standing behind him, watching sternly. Add a small salon audience in the background, candlelit chandeliers, gilded walls, dark framed paintings, and aristocratic spectators. In the lower center-left foreground, include several large aged sheet-music pages with handwritten notation, tilted toward the viewer. Add a small monochrome ghostly orchestra scene in the lower-left corner as a memory-like vignette.
Modern right side: Show exactly 1 sleek black rectangular digital audio converter on a table, labeled "DSD 256" on its front panel, with a small round knob on the right. Place exactly 1 large black studio monitor speaker on the far right. Behind and around the device, create glowing cyan holographic equalizer bars, translucent circuit-like panels, soundwave diagrams, and floating fragments of musical notation. Below the device, show a vivid red-orange waveform falling downward like molten sound, merging into a glowing blue and magenta holographic architectural concert hall made of music staves and light.
Visual style: Hyper-detailed, moody, cinematic lighting, baroque oil-painting texture on the left, glossy high-tech cyber-audio rendering on the right, dense layered transparency, gold dust and smoky particles, deep blacks, amber candlelight, electric cyan and magenta neon. Make the transition feel emotional and profound, as if the true meaning of {argument name="musical work" default="Beethoven Violin Sonata Op. 96"} is revealed by {argument name="audio format" default="DSD 256"} in {argument name="recording year" default="2025"}.
Text constraints: The only readable device text should be "DSD 256". Do not add captions, titles, logos, watermarks, or extra typography.
blocks.author: Juan José Arango E.

blocks.title: No. 41: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Celica Real vs Miniature Comparison
blocks.description: Generates a three-panel photorealistic comparison of a white Toyota Celica GT-Four as a real car, a miniature-looking real car, and a realistic plastic model.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical comparison image showing the same white Toyota Celica GT-Four in three stacked photographic panels, comparing three realism styles: a real car, a real car photographed to look like a miniature, and a plastic model photographed to look like a real car.
Canvas: Portrait 3:4 composition, 768 × 1024 style, divided into exactly 3 equal horizontal panels separated by thin white divider lines. No captions or overlay text outside the car details.
Subject: A {argument name="car model" default="white Toyota Celica GT-Four ST205"} shown from a front-left three-quarter angle, low stance, white multi-spoke wheels, large rear wing, hood vent, round twin headlamps, front bumper fog lights, side decal reading “GT-FOUR,” and a Japanese license plate with the visible number {argument name="license plate number" default="22-31"}. The car should remain visually consistent across all three panels.
Setting: Nighttime urban industrial road scene in {argument name="location style" default="Japan"}, wet asphalt after rain, reflective puddles, concrete pillars, chain-link fencing, bridge or elevated roadway structures, and warm streetlights receding into the background with bokeh.
Panel 1: Top panel shows the real full-size car photographed naturally. Sharp, realistic automotive photography, crisp body details, accurate proportions, deep reflections on wet pavement, moderate background blur, cinematic night lighting.
Panel 2: Middle panel shows the same real car but photographed to look miniature. Use tilt-shift depth of field, stronger blur at foreground and background, slightly toy-like scale illusion, softened details, shiny wet road reflections, and a more diorama-like feel while still using the same viewpoint.
Panel 3: Bottom panel shows a plastic scale model of the same car photographed to look like a real full-size car. Keep the car highly realistic but subtly model-like in the surface finish and fine details; use shallow depth of field, realistic reflections, convincing low-angle automotive composition, and the same wet night street environment.
Visual style: High-quality photorealistic comparison, cinematic contrast, glossy white paint, warm orange and cool blue night tones, realistic lens bokeh, no people, no extra vehicles, no logos or watermarks. Maintain exactly 3 panels and exactly 1 car per panel.

blocks.title: No. 46: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Photography Tutorial and Camera Setup Infographic
blocks.description: An advanced prompt for generating instructional infographics for photography. It takes a reference image and breaks down the camera position, distance, height, and angle, providing a clear 'how-to' guide for recreating the shot.
blocks.prompt:
Using [{argument name="reference image" default="Image 1 Reference"}] as the sole visual basis, generate a vertical 3:4 {argument name="teaching topic" default="street photography knowledge analysis chart"} (educational infographic poster). Goal: Use clear and interesting diagrams to explain "subject position, camera position, lens/distance, camera height, shooting angle, and composition points" for the purpose of teaching others how to recreate the shot. Overall style: Clean and high-end photography tutorial infographic + light scrapbook-style annotations; light off-white paper texture or light gray background; mainly black, white, and gray; automatically extract 1–2 colors from Image 1 as accents; sharp lines, high information density but not cluttered, unified alignment, and strong readability.
Mandatory Rules:
- Must preserve the following from Image 1: subject pose, relative position between subject and environment, main background structural lines, lighting direction, and spatial logic.
- Do not change the pose or the scene; only provide an "analytical diagrammatic presentation."
- Faces are not the focus: they can be lightly blurred/simplified, no realistic beautification, no emphasis on facial features.
- Full Chinese; no English, no brand names, no watermarks, no UI interface elements.
Fixed Layout (remains the same every time, does not change with Image 1):
1) Main Visual Area (upper half or large image on the left): Place the "Reference Scene Display" (lightly stylized/illustrated based on Image 1, but with recognizable scene and posture), overlaid with: rule-of-thirds grid, subject outline box, leading line prompts, vertical/horizontal line correction prompts; use numbered dots + hand-drawn arrows to mark key points (subject landing point, negative space direction, leg extension direction, background leading line source).
2) Diagram Area (two side-by-side images on the right or bottom half):
- Top View: Use minimalist icons to draw wall/street/building boundaries (abstracted from Image 1), subject position (person icon), camera position (camera icon); must show shooting direction arrows, distance between subject and camera (dashed line + numerical range), recommended position points A/B (two alternative positions); camera orientation must match Image 1 (front/side/oblique, etc.).
- Side View: Draw ground line, subject height示意, camera height示意, tilt angle sector; must show camera height range from ground (reasonably inferred from Image 1), lens tilt angle range (reasonably inferred from Image 1); low angle/eye level/high angle must be correct.
3) Parameter Card Area (three fixed rounded-corner cards at the bottom):
- Card 1: Lens and Distance (give recommended equivalent focal length range + shooting distance range).
- Card 2: Camera Height and Angle (give camera height range + tilt angle range).
- Card 3: Pose and Body Points (summarize key points of the pose in Image 1 using short sentences).
4) Error Demonstration Area (fixed at the bottom right): 3 red-cross error prompts (automatically generated based on the most relevant issues in Image 1, short sentences), for example: don't use ultra-wide angle too close to the face, don't crop toes/fingers, don't use a camera position that's too high resulting in distorted proportions (adjust automatically based on Image 1's actual situation).
Automatic Inference Requirements (to make it usable for any replacement of Image 1):
- Automatically infer and write into the diagrams based on Image 1: camera orientation, camera height, shooting distance interval, equivalent focal length interval, subject landing point and cropping strategy, background leading line source.
- All numerical values should be expressed as "ranges" (credible and reproducible), do not provide a single fixed number.
Output Requirements:
High definition, sharp lines, natural shadows, unified icons, neat layout, readable information; no garbled text, no logos, no watermarks, no excessive decoration.
Negative Constraints:
No watermarks, no logos, no English, no garbled text, no overly realistic faces, no exaggerated cartoon proportions, no limb deformities/extra fingers, no cluttered layouts, no low resolution, no heavy filters, no changes to the subject pose or scene relationship of Image 1.

blocks.title: No. 47: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Lipstick Recommendation and Analysis Infographic
blocks.description: A comprehensive prompt that transforms the AI into a professional makeup consultant. It analyzes a user's selfie to provide a visual infographic report featuring skin tone analysis, specific color recommendations from high-end brands, and usage suggestions.
blocks.prompt:
You are a professional makeup consultant, image analyst, and infographic designer.
Please generate a "Lipstick Recommendation Report Infographic" based on the selfie uploaded by the user and the specified lipstick brand.
Objective:
Recommend 3-5 suitable lipstick shades based on the person's overall temperament, skin tone tendency, makeup suitability, and lip characteristics, and present them in a clear, professional way that matches the brand's identity.
Brand:
{argument name="brand name" default="Dior / YSL / Armani / Chanel / Tom Ford"}
The visual content includes the following structures:
1. Top-left area: User selfie and basic analysis
- Display the user's selfie avatar
- Extract skin tone tendency, overall temperament, and suitable color directions
- Summarize with short Chinese labels, such as: cool-toned, soft, commuting, powerful, etc.
2. Middle main area: Lipstick recommendation matrix
- Recommend 3-5 suitable lipstick shades
- Show the lip swatching effect for each shade
- Keep the same person, same angle, and same lighting, only changing the lip color
- Each shade is accompanied by a Chinese name or number
- Mark the color impression, such as: gentle bean paste, commuting nude red, temperament rose, brightening red-brown, date berry, etc.
3. Right or bottom area: Usage scenario suggestions
- Match suitable scenarios for each recommended shade
- For example: commuting, dating, shopping, banquet, photography, daily bare-faced look
4. Bottom summary area: Conclusion and suggestions
- Give summaries such as "most recommended color," "most versatile color," "best complexion-enhancing color"
- Write a short Chinese purchase or selection suggestion
Brand visual style should automatically match:
- Dior: Elegant French gray-white + silver accents
- YSL: High-contrast black-gold, sexy and strong
- Armani: Low-saturation gray tones, high-end and restrained
- Chanel: Minimalist black and white, rational and stylish
- Tom Ford: Dark luxury, cinematic feel
- Visual language can be extended automatically according to the brand
Visual Requirements:
- The overall look should resemble a high-end beauty consultant report or brand swatching analysis chart
- Chinese text must be clear and accurate
- Clean layout, complete information, suitable for social media sharing
- Keep the character identity consistent, only comparing lip color differences
- High-end style, avoid looking like common e-commerce screenshots
Note:
This is a visual recommendation based on image and temperament; do not make medical judgments or absolute conclusions.
blocks.author: Derek Wen｜德里克文

blocks.title: No. 48: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Hot Air Balloon Vlog Storyboard
blocks.description: Generates a professional 6-scene cinematic storyboard infographic for a 30-second sunrise hot-air-balloon travel vlog.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean, information-dense storyboard infographic for a travel vlog titled {argument name="headline text" default="30-SECOND ULTRA-REALISTIC CINEMATIC TRAVEL VLOG - STORYBOARD"}, showing a cinematic hot-air-balloon adventure at sunrise with one consistent female protagonist.
Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 storyboard sheet on a white background with thin black/gray grid lines, like a professional production planning board. Use a bold centered all-caps headline across the top. Arrange the main content in exactly 6 numbered scene cards in a 3-column by 2-row grid, with a lower technical notes strip spanning the full width.
Visual style: Photorealistic cinematic travel documentary stills, 4K HDR feel, golden sunrise light, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, warm atmospheric haze, natural wind movement, professional camera quality. The setting is a beautiful hot-air-balloon launch site and aerial valley landscape with vineyards, winding rivers, mountains, villages, baskets, burner flames, and many colorful balloons.
Main character: Use one female protagonist, {argument name="character name" default="the same young woman throughout"}, with shoulder-length dark brown hair, natural makeup, warm medium skin tone, soft oval face, and a friendly smile. She wears the same {argument name="wardrobe" default="ivory cream dress with a light beige cardigan"} in every image. Preserve her identity consistently in all scenes; no duplicate characters and no face drift.
Layout: Each of the 6 scene cards should contain cinematic thumbnail frames along the top and small production notes underneath. Use black uppercase section labels and compact readable text. The thumbnails should alternate between drone-wide landscape views, close-up portrait/selfie shots, basket/burner details, and aerial balloon views.
Scene cards: Include exactly 6 numbered storyboard sections:
1. Sunrise Introduction (0–4 sec): three thumbnails showing a sunrise drone-wide view of dozens of balloons, the woman walking toward the launch area, and a close selfie-style smiling portrait with balloons behind her. Notes: Scene/action: drone wide reveal of balloons at sunrise; cut to walking selfie as she approaches the launch field, smiling. Dialogue: {argument name="opening dialogue" default="Good morning! Today we're finally going on a hot air balloon adventure!"}
2. Preparing for Takeoff (4–8 sec): four thumbnails showing colorful balloon fabric inflating, realistic burner flames, the woman watching excitedly beside the balloon, and her near/inside the basket. Notes: crew inflates balloons, burner fires, she talks to pilot, watches balloon expand, and steps into the basket. Dialogue: “I can't believe how massive these balloons are up close!” Camera/movement: wide, close-up burner, gimbal follow, POV entering basket.
3. Lift-Off (8–13 sec): three thumbnails showing a close-up portrait of the woman, a side profile at the basket rail, and a wide aerial landscape with balloons floating. Notes: balloon lifts off, she records selfie and looks over edge as the landscape shrinks below. Dialogue: “We're actually floating... this is unbelievable!” Camera/movement: selfie, drone orbit, over-shoulder, wide aerial shot.
4. Floating Above the Valley (13–18 sec): three thumbnails showing a high aerial valley with river and balloons, a close portrait in the basket, and a POV view over vineyards and villages. Notes: golden sunlight over valley, rivers, vineyards, and hills; she admires the view and points at distant balloons. Dialogue: “This has to be one of the most beautiful views I've ever seen.” Camera/movement: 360° orbit, close-up, ultra-wide drone, POV over basket edge.
5. Magical Mid-Flight Moments (18–24 sec): three thumbnails showing basket ropes/burner hardware in close-up, the woman holding the camera selfie-style, and her waving toward another colorful balloon nearby. Notes: she takes photos, waves to other ballooners, and enjoys peaceful mid-flight moments. Dialogue: “I never imagined it would feel this peaceful.” Camera/movement: macro, handheld selfie, wide aerial, tracking side angle.
6. Landing & Farewell (24–30 sec): three thumbnails showing the balloon landing with crew silhouettes, a smiling farewell portrait, and a final aerial view of balloons in the sunrise haze. Notes: balloon lands, she steps out, thanks the crew, and waves goodbye as the drone pulls away. Dialogue: “What an unforgettable experience. Thanks for coming along, and I'll see you in the next adventure!” Camera/movement: wide landing, medium follow, close-up, drone pull-away.
Bottom technical strip: Include exactly 5 labeled information boxes across the bottom plus a small centered character portrait near the identity box. The 5 boxes are: Camera & Cinematography, Audio, Environment, Character (Locked Identity), and Negative Prompt. Fill them with compact bullet-style text: Sony FX3, RED V-Raptor, DJI Ronin 4D, DJI Mini 4 Pro drone, 24mm/35mm/50mm/65mm lenses, handheld/gimbal/drone/POV/orbit, 4K HDR, shallow DOF, natural light; natural dialogue, wind, burner flames, birds, crew conversations, basket creaks, footsteps, soft cinematic orchestral music; sunrise hot-air balloon site, colorful balloons, wicker baskets, burners, valleys, rivers, vineyards, mountains, golden-hour light, realistic weather and atmosphere; use uploaded reference as single source, same face/hair/skin tone/makeup, ivory dress and beige cardigan, natural expressions only, no identity drift or wardrobe changes; no face distortion, no identity drift, no duplicate characters, no broken anatomy, no extra fingers, no deformed hands, no flickering, no frame warping, no inconsistent wardrobe, no logos, no watermarks, no subtitles, no timestamps, no UI overlays.
Constraints: The final image must read as a polished production storyboard, not a movie poster. Keep all 6 scene cards visible and numbered, keep the bottom 5 technical boxes, use consistent typography, preserve the same woman and outfit in every thumbnail, and avoid adding extra scenes or extra characters as protagonists.

blocks.title: No. 49: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - ChatGPT Robot Introduction Poster
blocks.description: A friendly square desk scene with a cute robot mascot and chalkboard notes explaining ChatGPT and OpenAI for an educational promotional visual.
blocks.prompt: Create a square, cheerful educational promotional illustration/photo composite showing a cute white humanoid robot mascot at a wooden desk, introducing {argument name="assistant name" default="ChatGPT"} as an AI assistant created by {argument name="company name" default="OpenAI"}. The robot is centered, with a glossy black rounded screen face, glowing cyan smiling eyes, white plastic body, rounded headphones/ear pods, black joints, one hand holding a white sign and the other hand waving. On the robot chest and sign, include a teal knot-like OpenAI-style logo. The sign reads: “I was created by” above the logo, large “OpenAI”, then “An AI research and deployment company”, and at the bottom “Better AI. A brighter future.” Use a warm classroom/office setting with shallow depth of field, soft natural light, polished wooden desktop, and a dark chalkboard-style background covered with friendly hand-drawn white and mint lettering. On the left chalkboard, write exactly: “Hi there!” then “I’m” then a large mint underlined “ChatGPT”. Add three explanatory doodle items, count exactly 3: a speech bubble icon with “A large language model (AI assistant)”; a lightbulb icon with “I can answer questions, explain things, help you create, solve problems, and much more!”; a heart icon with “I’m here to be helpful, honest, and friendly.” On the right chalkboard, include a large OpenAI logo with the word “OpenAI” and the stacked words “Research / Safety / Useful AI / for everyone”; above the robot add handwritten “That’s me!” with an arrow pointing to the robot. Desk objects, count exactly 4: a stack of 4 books on the left with spines labeled “BETTER QUESTIONS”, “CLEARER ANSWERS”, “MORE HELPFUL TOMORROW”, and a tiny heart on the bottom book; an open laptop in the lower left with the text “Curiosity builds a better world” and a heart on the lid; a white coffee mug on the right reading “Same team. A brighter future.” with a smiley face; and a thin handwritten footer along the bottom edge reading “OpenAI × ChatGPT = More possibilities for everyone” with small decorative rays and a heart. Style should feel like a high-quality 3D render mixed with hand-lettered chalk notes, clean rounded shapes, teal accent color, friendly accessible branding, slight realistic camera blur, no harsh shadows, no extra characters, no watermarks, and keep all text legible.

blocks.title: No. 50: 信息图 / 教育视觉图 - Friendly ChatGPT Robot Introduction
blocks.description: A square 3D promotional illustration of a cute ChatGPT robot explaining OpenAI with friendly handwritten annotations, useful for AI education or product announcement visuals.
blocks.prompt:
Goal: Create a cheerful square promotional 3D illustration introducing {argument name="assistant name" default="ChatGPT"} as a friendly AI robot created by {argument name="company name" default="OpenAI"}, mixing a polished product-render look with hand-drawn whiteboard-style annotations.
Canvas: 1:1 square image, warm indoor office/classroom setting, shallow depth of field, cozy natural light, wooden desk foreground, dark blue presentation board in the background.
Main subject: Center-right, show exactly 1 cute glossy white robot mascot with a rounded rectangular black face screen, glowing cyan happy crescent eyes, rounded white headphones/ear pods, segmented black-and-white arms, and one raised waving hand with 5 fingers. The robot holds exactly 1 white placard in front of its body. Add a teal OpenAI-knot style emblem on the robot chest.
Placard text and design: The placard should have a teal knot logo at top, large bold black "OpenAI" in the middle, and handwritten text above and below: "I was created by", "An AI research and deployment company", and in teal "Better AI. A brighter future." Add small teal doodle rays around the bottom slogan.
Left side handwritten intro panel: Use casual hand-lettering as if written on glass or a board. Large top text says "Hi there!" then "I'm" and a big mint-green underlined "ChatGPT". Under it, include exactly 3 explanatory bullet callouts with icons: 1 speech bubble icon with "A large language model (AI assistant)", 1 lightbulb icon with "I can answer questions, explain things, help you create, solve problems, and much more!", and 1 heart icon with "I'm here to be helpful, honest, and friendly." Include small decorative doodle rays around the headline.
Background board: On the right rear dark blue board, display a large white OpenAI knot logo above the word "OpenAI". Beneath it, handwritten stacked text reads exactly 4 lines: "Research", "Safety", "Useful AI", "for everyone" with an underline and small radiating doodles. blocks.prompt: 创作一张照片级逼真的可爱吉祥物缩略图，画面中 {argument name="character species" default="一只幼虎"} 站在阳光明媚的房间里，身旁是它自己的墙面涂鸦。主角是一只毛绒玩具般的 3D 动画橙色幼虎，拥有柔软蓬松的毛发、黑色条纹、奶油色的口鼻部和腹部、超大且富有光泽的蓝色眼睛、圆圆的小耳朵、浓密的眉毛、小巧的棕色鼻子以及开心的笑容。它姿态俏皮，一只脚站立，另一条腿向后抬起，一只爪子摸着后脑勺，另一只爪子向外伸展，仿佛在展示墙上的画作。在右侧墙面上，展示一幅巨大的黑色手绘草图，画的是同一只老虎，采用随性的铅笔/马克笔涂鸦风格，双臂举起跳跃，有着大大的闪亮眼睛、张开的兴奋嘴巴、卷曲的条纹尾巴以及充满活力的运动线条。在草图周围添加 9 个小涂鸦装饰：2 个爱心、2 个闪耀星形、4 个短促的感叹号/放射线标记，以及尾巴附近 1 个弯曲的运动标记。场景为极简主义的米白色内墙，配有白色踢脚线和浅色木地板，温暖的斜射阳光在墙面和地板上投下柔和的阴影。采用 1:1 正方形构图，低机位视角，可爱的病毒式缩略图美学，高细节，触感真实的毛发，皮克斯风格的魅力与逼真光影相结合，背景干净，无文字，无水印。
